video_title: REACTION: Steph Curry Gets HONEST About Future With Warriors

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry using free agency as a tool to pressure Warriors
quotes.excerpt: the more you can bet Curry's using potential free agency as a tool to keep the Warriors pushing
quotes.quote: He wants to win. He wants the best team the Warriors can assemble around him. He wants a chance, a real chance, for a deep playoff run. The longer it takes for him to sign a contract extension, the more you can bet Curry's using potential free agency as a tool to keep the Warriors pushing toward that end.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's massive salary makes winning championships difficult for Warriors
quotes.excerpt: the Warriors aren't going to be winning with Steph Curry making 60 plus million dollars a year
quotes.quote: Listen, do 62.6 million dollars this year, that makes him one of the highest paid players in the league. Is an extension at or more than that number? If it is, it's a lifetime achievement award. Because the Warriors aren't going to be winning with Steph Curry making 60 plus million dollars a year. He's still playing at an awfully high level, but there's not going to be, and quite frankly, the idea that the Warriors are or even a move, even a big move away from being a contender, it's not an idea that's based in reality.

quotes.speaker: Marcus Thompson II
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' championship window has closed in the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: team championship windows in today's NBA don't stay open this long

text_blocks.speaker: Marcus Thompson II
text_blocks.text: Team championship windows in today's NBA don't stay open this long. If you started at 2013 when they lost in the second round to San Antonio and you could see that they were coming, and you saw Draymond Green, you could see that Steph and Klay Thompson, they were coming. Mark Jackson was still coaching their team. If you start there and you end it in 2023 when they lose in the second round to LeBron James and Anthony Davis and those Lakers in that championship reign, that's a 10-year window. I need people to understand, that never happens in today's NBA. LeBron leaves after four years at a place. The Kobe Bryant back end of the Lakers went to the finals in '08 and by 2011 they were getting swept in the second round. These things don't happen often.

quotes.speaker: Marcus Thompson II
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors are trying to plan ahead of Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: we're trying to plan ahead of Steph Curry as opposed to, hey man, let's see if we can maximize
quotes.quote: This whole two timeline garbage that they were trying to pull off, that's where all of this sort of stems from is, we're trying to plan ahead of Steph Curry as opposed to, hey man, let's see if we can maximize and make the best of this. Steph is never really threatened to go anywhere and the Warriors know that and that's why they've been able to do the things that they've been doing. If Steph kicked it a completely different way, then we would be having different conversations.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green can get a no-trade clause in new contract
quotes.excerpt: because this is going to be a brand new contract, Draymond can get a no trade clause
quotes.quote: So Draymond as we know is a free agent. He opted out of the contract. Because this is going to be a brand new contract, Draymond can get a no trade clause. If, you know, and last year like there was a moment where Draymond thought that there was a chance he could get traded. Do you remember that press conference right before the deadline where he like had like a quasi goodbye?

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors can stomach a divorce with Draymond Green
quotes.excerpt: the Warriors clearly can stomach a divorce with Draymond. They went through a pretty messy divorce with Clay Thompson
quotes.quote: You know, honestly, the Warriors clearly can stomach a divorce with Draymond. They went through a pretty messy divorce with Clay Thompson. Steph is the one I don't think they can stomach that and so that's where, you know, the even the threat of Steph just sniffing around.
